question:

Which of the following statements about the gas after this change is/are correct?

1  The final temperature of the gas is the same as before the change.
2  The final internal energy of the gas is the same as before the change.
3  The final mean kinetic energy of the particles of the gas is the same as before the change.

question:

Which other action, performed separately, produces a current in the same direction?

choices.A: inserting the S-pole of the magnet into the right-hand end of the coil
choices.B: inserting the S-pole of the magnet into the left-hand end of the coil

choices.D: withdrawing the S-pole of the magnet from the right-hand end of the coil
choices.E: inserting the N-pole of the magnet into the right-hand end of the coil
